name: 翡翠叶纹
design: R COMMON: restrained fresh mint/emerald enamel with warm ivory-silver metal rails; rounded clover-leaf filigree at four corners, tiny pale-green cabochons, a few cream botanical curls. Friendly, elegant, modest decoration, clearly green. Avoid gold domination. Smooth straightforward thin edge rails.
prompt: Create ONE premium decorative GAME CARD BORDER ASSET for a cozy fairy-tale board game. Square 1024x1024 canvas, an EXACT FRONT-ON square rounded rectangular picture-frame rim. The CENTER must be fully EMPTY REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA, as must all pixels OUTSIDE the frame. No white or gray backing and no checkerboard baked in. This is ONLY the frame, NOT a card illustration. No girl, no characters, no scenery, no filled panel, no text, no letters, no numbers, no badge, no watermark. The reference is ONLY for the soft rounded 3D toy/clay collectible-card MATERIALS and border language; ignore ALL its character, text and scenery. The rim touches near all four canvas edges with at most 1% outside transparent margin. Design for CSS NINE-SLICE: every elaborate motif must fit ENTIRELY inside the four corner squares, each at most 16% of canvas width/height. Midsections of all four edges must be simple straight consistent-thickness metal/enamel rails, so they can be stretched to a tall card WITHOUT stretching a jewel or medallion. No centered top/bottom emblem. Keep all material within the outer 12% rim; the central 72% by 72% must be absolutely transparent. Fine polished embossed scrollwork, soft bevels, tasteful cast-metal highlights; visual quality of a luxurious cute collectible game item, clean silhouette and crisp transparent cutout edges. All levels share the same overall framing geometry and increase in detail with rarity.
